text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive connective at the ayah opening
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a connected command unit rather than an isolated order. It carries the prior promise-warning frame of 24:55 into the first imperative while also launching fresh direct address, and its recurrence before the next imperatives helps form the three-beat command sequence.

topics.headline: opening connector carries the prior frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first command as the constructive continuation of 24:55, not as a detached new instruction.
topics.reason: The initial connective is licensed as coordination/resumption at the boundary and is not contradicted by the local command syntax.

topics.headline: single-letter onset compresses transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary relation is packed into the command onset before the imperative arrives.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the first command and creates a visible/audible link before the verb.

topics.headline: first repeated connector begins the tricolon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first beat of a repeated connector-plus-command pattern that will bind three duties into one response.
topics.reason: The three coordinated imperative clauses support the tricolon reading.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative: cause the prayer to stand as an established practice
words.root_gloss_range: standing, uprightness, maintenance, rectification, community, and final-standing associations; local grammar selects causative establishment of prayer

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: known prayer institution governed as object

words.prose: {{ar:أَقِيمُوا}} ({{tr:aqīmū}}) is a direct 2mp command with its subject carried in the ending and {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāta}}) as its explicit object. The promised community of 24:55 is now addressed as responsible actors, and the standard prayer-establishment formula sets the template for the following duties. The Form IV causative makes the duty more than personal standing or occasional attendance: the addressees must make the prayer stand as a maintained institution. Root-family uprightness, rectification, community, and final-standing associations add pressure, but local grammar keeps the selected sense on establishing prayer; even the firm qāf onset and held ī cadence suit the first beat's upright weight.

topics.headline: plural imperative makes obligation immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promised community of 24:55 addressed directly as responsible actors.
topics.reason: The 2mp imperative morphology supplies direct address with a recoverable pro-dropped subject.

topics.headline: Form IV makes prayer stand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is to maintain an instituted prayer, not merely to stand or perform a private act.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV and governs the prayer noun directly, licensing causative establishment.

topics.headline: uprightness and rectification pressure the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels establishment as keeping prayer upright and aligned, while the local form prevents replacing it with a different rectification or straight-path verb.
topics.reason: Related q-w-m branches add semantic pressure, but the local surface is Form IV establishment, not Form II rectification or Form X uprightness.

topics.headline: standing field reaches community and final-standing associations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that establishing prayer resonates with communal standing and final standing without making those the local lexical sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports these associations as background pressure, while the direct object and Form IV command select prayer-establishment.

topics.headline: recognized prayer-establishment formula begins the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the opening as a standard legislative formula that sets the template for the following duties.
topics.reason: The command plus prayer object is a recurrent formula and occupies the first verb-object slot in the local sequence.

topics.headline: broad promise narrows into concrete action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior eligibility language converted into the first concrete duty of the command frame.
topics.reason: At the ayah boundary the first imperative turns the preceding promise context into an actionable directive.

topics.headline: held sound suits the upright command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear the first command as acoustically weighty, with a held cadence matching its establishment sense.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is locally tied to the same surface form and does not alter the parse.

words.gloss_range: the known instituted prayer as the accusative object of establishment
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, supplication, following/connection, bodily nearness; local phrase selects instituted ritual prayer as object of establishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first imperative command to establish prayer

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāta}}) is the explicit accusative object that closes the first command beat. Its definiteness points to the known prayer institution, and its gerund-like singular form gathers repeated acts into one maintained duty. The wider root pressures of following closely, embodied orientation, and supplication enrich the object, but the local phrase selects instituted prayer established by {{ar:أَقِيمُوا}} ({{tr:aqīmū}}). As the opening half of the familiar prayer-zakāt pair, it anticipates the next object before messenger-obedience expands the sequence; same-surah prayer scenes (24:37, 24:41, 24:58) and the assimilated article keep this object locally resonant and tightly bound to its command. Across the boundary, the prior servitude frame takes concrete ritual form in this named prayer.

topics.headline: accusative object closes the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prayer as the thing acted upon and maintained, not as a loose adverbial idea.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the noun as direct object of the first imperative.

topics.headline: definite singular names the known institution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah points to the recognized prayer institution rather than any improvised act of prayer.
topics.reason: The definite singular noun form supports an identifiable institutional object.

topics.headline: following and embodied nearness remain as pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels prayer as maintained connection and embodied orientation while the command frame keeps the local sense on instituted prayer.
topics.reason: The derivational/root-image material is valid as pressure, but it cannot displace the governed noun sense of ritual prayer.

topics.headline: gerund-like noun gathers repeated acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many performances gathered into one obligation that can be established as a whole.
topics.reason: The local noun is singular and definite, and contextual evidence treats the gerund prayer noun as dominant.

topics.headline: first object anticipates the zakāt partner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the first object as the opening half of the familiar prayer-zakāt pair before the third duty expands the sequence.
topics.reason: The prayer noun is immediately followed by the coordinated zakāt command, matching a frequent legislative pairing.

topics.headline: local recurrence and sound bind the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this prayer object as both locally resonant in Surah 24 and tightly bound to its governing command.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence and surface assimilation support echo and sound observations without changing the syntax.

topics.headline: worship becomes the prayer object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior servitude frame take a concrete ritual form in the named prayer.
topics.reason: The first direct object supplies a concrete ritual expression after the preceding boundary frame.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector before the second imperative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second imperative command to give zakāt

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) launches {{ar:ءَاتُوا}} ({{tr:ātū}}) as a new finite command while keeping it equal to the first. It is the hinge from the prayer object to the zakāt object: additive, equalizing, and visibly part of the same repeated command-opening pattern.

topics.headline: second connector equalizes the zakāt command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees giving zakāt as a coordinate obligation, not as a subordinate result of prayer.
topics.reason: The attachment analysis coordinates the second imperative with the first.

topics.headline: connector pivots from ritual to economic duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence shift domains while preserving the same command rank.
topics.reason: The connector stands between the first object and the second imperative and marks linked parity.

topics.headline: proclitic repeats the written command onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see the tricolon forming at the level of repeated written attachment.
topics.reason: The particle is fused to the second imperative onset, matching the repeated connector pattern.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative: give/deliver zakāt as caused arrival
words.root_gloss_range: coming, bringing, giving, performing/committing; local Form IV with object selects caused transfer/delivery

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: known zakāt due governed as object

words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتُوا}} ({{tr:ātū}}) renews the 2mp imperative and governs {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) as its explicit object. The same addressed group is personally activated as givers, and the Form IV transfer sense turns the root idea of coming into caused arrival: the due must be made to reach its destination. The omitted recipient keeps attention on delivery of the obligation itself, while the active command makes the addressees donors rather than recipients. As the middle member of the standard prayer-zakāt legal formula, this is not loose generosity; the hamza onset also gives the second command its own audible restart while it repeats the same verb-plus-object template.

topics.headline: active imperative makes the addressees deliver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same addressed group personally activated as givers, not merely described or treated as recipients.
topics.reason: The verb is active 2mp imperative with a recoverable subject.

topics.headline: giving is framed as caused arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that zakāt is not merely possessed or felt generously; it must be transferred until it arrives.
topics.reason: Even though V4 root detail is missing for this root, QAC and attachment evidence license the Form IV transitive transfer frame.

topics.headline: recipient is omitted while object remains explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command concentrate on delivering the due itself rather than identifying a receiver in this clause.
topics.reason: The frame has an explicit object and no recipient phrase.

topics.headline: coming and performance senses enrich transfer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels giving as an enacted moral delivery, while the local Form IV keeps the sense on transfer rather than bare coming.
topics.reason: The row family has a valid root-range insight, but the local surface and object narrow it to giving/delivery.

topics.headline: recognized zakāt-giving formula fills the middle beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the middle command as the standard legal partner to prayer, not a loose charitable aside.
topics.reason: The command appears in the recognized prayer-zakāt sequence and occupies the middle verb-object slot.

topics.headline: second beat restarts with a distinct onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a separate second command even as it repeats the same template.
topics.reason: The second imperative is coordinated and has its own surface onset.

words.gloss_range: the known zakāt institution as the accusative object delivered by the giving command
words.root_gloss_range: purity, growth, increase, and purifying action; local noun selects the due whose delivery enacts that field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: known prayer institution governed as object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) is the explicit accusative object of the giving command and closes the second beat in parallel with {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāta}}). Its definite singular abstract form treats zakāt as a known institution, not indefinite charity. The z-k-w field holds purification and growth together, so the delivered portion is not just money transferred; purifying action is packaged as a due to be delivered. In the middle object slot, zakāt becomes the meeting point of the prayer-zakāt pair and the giving-zakāt formula, balancing the ritual object before it with the messenger object after it.

topics.headline: accusative zakāt closes the second beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees zakāt as the concrete object delivered by the command, matching the first beat’s object closure.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the second imperative.

topics.headline: definite singular frames the known due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognized obligation rather than an indefinite charitable impulse.
topics.reason: The definite singular abstract noun is governed as an explicit institutional object.

topics.headline: zakāt joins purification and growth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the paradox that giving away the due functions as purification and growth rather than simple loss.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports both purity and increase, and the giving verb makes the paradox local.

topics.headline: purifying verbs remain packaged in the noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels purifying action behind the due, while the local wording keeps purification packaged as the object to be delivered.
topics.reason: Related verbal derivatives color the noun but are not the local finite command.

topics.headline: zakāt intersects prayer and giving formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees zakāt as the meeting point of the prayer-zakāt pair and the giving-zakāt formula.
topics.reason: The noun is paired with prayer in sequence and governed by the giving verb.

topics.headline: middle object balances the tricolon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle object balancing ritual and messenger-authority objects while echoing the local purification field.
topics.reason: The noun occupies the second object slot between prayer and messenger and has same-surah/corpus echo support.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector before the third imperative
words.prose: The third {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents messenger-obedience from being absorbed into the zakāt command. It adds a third equal finite command and also completes the tricolon’s climb from ritual duty, to economic duty, to response to the messenger.

topics.headline: third connector launches an equal command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience to the messenger as its own coordinate obligation, not a supplement to zakāt.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the third imperative with the previous command.

topics.headline: connector pivots into the authority domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both parity and escalation as the sequence moves into messenger-obedience.
topics.reason: The third connector adds a command while its position closes the three-beat structure.

topics.headline: visible onset pattern is completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the third fused connector complete the repeated command-opening morphology.
topics.reason: The same proclitic-plus-imperative onset pattern recurs at the third command.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative: obey the messenger with directed willing compliance
words.root_gloss_range: willingness, pliability, obedience, compliance, and capacity; local Form IV command selects directed obedience to a stated authority
words.prose: {{ar:أَطِيعُوا}} ({{tr:aṭīʿū}}) renews the direct 2mp command and takes {{ar:ٱلرَّسُولَ}} ({{tr:al-rasūla}}) as its object, so obedience is neither generic nor objectless. The same addressed community moves through a new duty without a change of audience. The root field of willingness and pliability makes obedience volitional alignment rather than mere external compliance, while the imperative keeps it obligatory and blocks treating it as optional volunteering. The chosen Form IV asks for self-alignment to the messenger, not abstract ability or making others comply. Placed third, this known messenger-obedience formula compresses the authority focus seen nearby (24:54), expands the tricolon from ritual and economic duties into communal allegiance, and prepares the shift from human action to received mercy.

topics.headline: imperative governs the messenger directly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience aimed at a specified authority rather than left as an abstract virtue.
topics.reason: The third imperative has a direct object, the messenger noun.

topics.headline: same addressees remain under a new verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one addressed community moving through different duties without a change of audience.
topics.reason: The 2mp ending and repeated imperative cadence sustain the same address frame.

topics.headline: willingness and pliability shape obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels obedience as volitional alignment, while the command prevents treating it as optional volunteering.
topics.reason: The root field supports willingness/pliability pressure, narrowed by imperative force and direct-object syntax.

topics.headline: capacity and coercion alternatives mark the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command ask for self-alignment to the messenger, not ability in the abstract or control over others.
topics.reason: Related derivatives are valid contrasts, but the local verb is Form IV obedience, not Form X ability or Form II making-compliant.

topics.headline: messenger-obedience formula carries authority register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the third beat as a known messenger-obedience formula, compressed here onto the messenger object.
topics.reason: The root co-occurs strongly with messenger language, and same-surah context supports the authority formula.

topics.headline: third command expands the tricolon’s scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sequence climb from worship practice and material due to communal allegiance.
topics.reason: The third command is coordinated after two object-duty commands and before the passive result clause.

topics.headline: worship frame becomes messenger-obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior covenantal/worship frame become concrete as obedience to the messenger in Surah 24’s authority cluster.
topics.reason: The local command belongs to a recurring obedience formula and same-surah authority context.

topics.headline: active commands prepare the passive result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates the grammatical shift from human action to received mercy after the third imperative.
topics.reason: The third active imperative immediately precedes the purpose/result clause.

words.gloss_range: the known messenger as the accusative object of obedience
words.root_gloss_range: sending, release/flow, envoy, message-bearing mission; local noun selects the concrete recognized messenger-role
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّسُولَ}} ({{tr:al-rasūla}}) is the explicit accusative object of {{ar:أَطِيعُوا}} ({{tr:aṭīʿū}}), so the third command lands on a known messenger rather than generic obedience. The noun names a concrete role-bearing envoy who carries the sending and message field, not an abstract message alone or a merely passive sent status. As the final object of the tricolon, it is the formulaic authority endpoint: the sequence moves from institutions to the personal authority through whom command and transmission are mediated. Because this messenger-response stands immediately before the passive mercy clause and echoes the nearby obedience formula (24:54), it is part of the route toward mercy rather than an isolated authority note.

topics.headline: known messenger is the obedience object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the authority route fixed on the recognized messenger, not left generic or indefinite.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative, and the direct object of the obedience command.

topics.headline: messenger carries sending and mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obedience attaches to an envoy authorized by sending and message-bearing mission.
topics.reason: The r-s-l lexical field supports sent-envoy and message-bearing senses, and the local noun selects that role.

topics.headline: rasūl form names a concrete role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience directed to the concrete role-bearing envoy, not merely to an abstract mission or a passive sent status.
topics.reason: The selected noun is concrete, definite, singular, and role-bearing.

topics.headline: object completes the messenger-obedience formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the third object as the formulaic authority endpoint of the command sequence.
topics.reason: The object completes a recurring obedience-to-messenger formula with same-surah repetition at 24:54 and 24:56.

topics.headline: messenger response sits before mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees messenger-response as part of the path toward the passive mercy clause, not as an isolated authority note.
topics.reason: The messenger object stands between the obedience command and the purpose/result mercy clause, within a Surah 24 authority cluster.

topics.headline: authority object closes the third beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tricolon landing on its most personal and authority-loaded object.
topics.reason: The messenger noun is the final object before the purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: modal/purpose particle introducing hoped result with attached 2mp pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّ}} ({{tr:laʿalla}}) pivots the ayah out of the three active commands and into the passive mercy clause. With the attached 2mp pronoun, it carries the same addressees into the hoped result; as a modal particle, it keeps mercy genuinely sought and purposed without turning it into a mechanical wage. Its position makes the closure modal before it becomes verbal, and the geminated form gives the hinge a compact audible pressure before the passive verb arrives.

topics.headline: suffix carries the same addressees into mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the commanded actors become the hoped-for recipients without a change of audience.
topics.reason: The attached pronoun is governed by the particle and continues the 2mp address frame.

topics.headline: particle governs the closing result clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mercy clause as the hoped outcome of the whole command series, not only of the third command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the particle clause as the purpose/hoped result of the command sequence.

topics.headline: hope modality prevents mechanical earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obedience is directed toward mercy but does not compel mercy as a transaction.
topics.reason: The particle carries hope/expectation modality after imperatives, qualifying the result as hoped rather than guaranteed by mechanics.

topics.headline: particle breaks the imperative pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from duty to result at exactly this particle.
topics.reason: The clause architecture changes from coordinated imperatives to an uncoordinated purpose/result clause.

topics.headline: geminated particle compresses the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see and hear the compact modal hinge before the passive verb.
topics.reason: The surface form is a fixed annulling/modal particle with gemination.

words.gloss_range: imperfect passive 2mp: you are shown/receive mercy as hoped result
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, tenderness with beneficence, protective/enclosing care, and divine attribute field; local passive verb selects reception of mercy by the addressees
words.prose: {{ar:تُرْحَمُونَ}} ({{tr:turḥamūna}}) closes the ayah by reversing agency: after three active commands, the addressees become passive recipients of mercy. The 2mp ending keeps the same group in view, while the passive suppresses the agent and foregrounds reception. The imperfect form makes the hoped result ongoing rather than completed, and the r-ḥ-m field frames that result as enclosing, beneficent, protective care rather than a generic reward paid out for performance. The marked passive recipient-form specializes the wider mercy-name and attribute network into direct reception by this audience. It also resolves the three-command series into one hoped divine response, links final mercy to obedience and messenger-response, contrasts the rupture and disbelief warnings around the 24:55-24:57 boundary, and closes with a plural cadence that echoes the command endings while softening into mercy rather than inserting a fourth supplicatory command.

topics.headline: passive turns actors into recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah end not on human achievement but on mercy received.
topics.reason: The verb is passive and follows three active imperative clauses.

topics.headline: same 2mp group becomes mercy recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same audience carried from command endings into passive recipienthood.
topics.reason: The 2mp morphology and particle complement continue the addressee chain.

topics.headline: imperfect passive keeps mercy open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mercy as hoped ongoing reception rather than a completed past event.
topics.reason: The local form is imperfect passive, not perfect passive.

topics.headline: mercy means protective care, not generic reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the result as enclosing, beneficent care rather than a generic success-payment.
topics.reason: The root field supports tenderness, beneficence, and enclosure imagery, while the local verb keeps the sense on receiving mercy, not literal womb placement.

topics.headline: broader mercy names load the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this passive verb as a specialized recipient-form within a much wider mercy lexeme network.
topics.reason: Related mercy nouns and attributes provide field pressure, but the local form is the passive verb.

topics.headline: rare passive form participates in mercy formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a marked recipient-focused form rather than a common mercy noun or attribute.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks this exact passive form as low-occurrence and formulaically tied to obedience/discipline contexts.

topics.headline: three commands resolve in one passive result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees multiple obligations compressed into one hoped divine response, making the endpoint asymmetrical with the effort that precedes it.
topics.reason: The final passive verb is governed by the purpose particle after three coordinated active imperatives.

topics.headline: mercy enclosure contrasts rupture and warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mercy ending set against the surrounding rupture and disbelief warnings, especially across the 24:55-24:57 boundary.
topics.reason: The boundary rows provide concrete neighboring-context contrast around 24:55, 24:56, and 24:57.

topics.headline: mercy follows obedience and messenger fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees final mercy as connected to the obedience and messenger sequence rather than detached consolation.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and same-surah recurrence connect mercy with the preceding command fields.

topics.headline: final sound returns the addressee cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing passive cadence echo the plural command endings while softening the move into mercy.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the final surface form and its 2mp ending.

topics.headline: passive result is not a direct supplication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes with hoped reception, not with a direct mercy-request inserted as a fourth command.
topics.reason: The local form is a passive imperfect under the purpose particle, not an imperative request.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives أَقِيمُوا, آتُوا, أَطِيعُوا and the purpose clause لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maintaining the prescribed prayer, transferring the purifying due, and aligning action with the carried message form one ordered practice-chain; the passive mercy clause makes received care its horizon rather than a possession produced at will.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and maintenance make إقامة an ongoing practice rather than a one-time performance.
The specified worship supplies the maintained practice's concrete ritual object.
Giving makes zakat an actual transfer rather than an inward attitude.
Purity and repair make the transferred due socially and morally cleansing.
Responsive compliance supplies the transition from hearing an instruction to enacting it.
The messenger is the bearer of the message to which conduct is aligned.
Tender care and beneficence name the received outcome toward which the chain points.

changed_reading.before: Three adjacent religious duties followed by a general hope for mercy.
changed_reading.after: A linked maintenance-transfer-response sequence by which a community places itself within reach of received care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of إقامة, إيتاء, طاعة, رسالة, and رحمة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be modeled as a social support system: prayer is kept standing as a load-bearing order, wealth is directed into growth, the message passes into willing action, and mercy appears as relational cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Support, subsistence, and structural upkeep make prayer a communal load-bearing practice.
The image of directing a watercourse contributes a bounded-flow analogy for transferring resources.
Growth and increase identify the intended productive effect of the transferred due.
Agreement between parties supplies a relational, not merely coercive, model of response.
Sending and release make the message something transmitted into social motion.
Kinship makes mercy the cohesion of related people as well as affective kindness.

changed_reading.before: Independent ritual, fiscal, and authority obligations.
changed_reading.after: Interdependent supports and flows that keep a related body standing, nourished, and responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's zakat is set against a context where corruption advances by followed footsteps and where no person purifies independently while God purifies whom he wills. Giving zakat therefore participates in interrupting incremental contamination and receiving purification; it is not a self-certified purity payment.

activation_trace.role: Tracking trace after trace supplies the incremental mechanism by which a harmful course is sustained.
Followable footprints turn moral drift into a sequence of small reproducible moves.
The paired denial of self-purification and divine purification relocates cleansing outside human self-authorization.
The same purity branch anchors the contextual contrast directly in the commanded zakat.

structural_cues: 24:21 repeats the root of zakat twice in a negated-human/divine-agent contrast.
The prohibition against following steps precedes the purification contrast, giving contamination a sequential shape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise following and the human/divine purification contrast; I infer that zakat interrupts a reproduced path and submits purification to divine agency. A live alternative is that 24:21 concerns personal moral purity while 24:56 uses only the fiscal institution.

changed_reading.before: Give a due whose name connotes purity.
changed_reading.after: Enter a divinely enabled purification process that counters the small repeated steps by which communal harm spreads.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inside raised houses of remembrance, the exact prayer-zakat pair withstands the pull of profit and exchange while hearts and sight face reversal. The pair becomes a counter-commercial rhythm that stabilizes attention and redistributes value within an illuminated communal setting.

activation_trace.role: Elevation gives the repeated practices a built and publicly maintained setting.
Diversion by one thing from another names the attentional force the practices resist.
Profit-seeking supplies one concrete rival claim on attention.
Exchange for price supplies the transaction field within which zakat redirects value.
Maintenance makes prayer a durable counter-rhythm rather than a momentary interruption.
The prescribed prayer is the repeated practice that orders attention.
Actual transfer prevents the commercial counter-rhythm from remaining purely contemplative.
Productive increase contests profit's monopoly on what counts as growth.
Expected danger explains why continuity of practice is tested rather than assumed.
Reversal supplies the volatility against which the maintained pair braces heart and perception.

structural_cues: 24:36-38 places raised houses, remembrance, trade, the exact prayer-zakat pair, fear, reversal, recompense, and increase in one sequence.
The negative construction makes commerce and sale potential distractors rather than forbidden domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a house setting, commercial distraction, the exact pair, and promised increase; I infer that prayer orders attention while zakat redirects value within commerce. The pair may alternatively be two independent proofs of devotion with no institutional mechanism between them.

changed_reading.before: Maintain prayer and pay zakat as two personal duties.
changed_reading.after: Maintain a house-based counter-rhythm that keeps worship and redistributive growth operative inside, and against capture by, ordinary exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The declaration that every creature knows its prayer and glorification, with birds extended in rows, expands the focus prayer from an isolated human rite into a human mode of a wider creature-specific order. Establishing it is joining knowingly patterned praise rather than inventing sacred attention from nothing.

activation_trace.role: Glorification and prayer explicitly overlap as forms of creaturely worship.
Flight supplies a nonhuman bodily mode in which the wider worship is displayed.
Alignment on a level line gives the birds' worship a visible ordered form.
Known and disclosed patterning prevents the creatures' prayer from being reduced to accidental motion.
Prayer as praise or supplication permits distinct creaturely forms without forcing the human rite onto them.
The focus's prescribed human prayer anchors the broadened creaturely model in a concrete obligation.

structural_cues: كل قد علم صلاته وتسبيحه attributes a known prayer-pattern to each member of the preceding cosmic set.
The bird-row image supplies visible embodied order immediately before the universal statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creature-specific knowledge, prayer, glorification, and ordered flight; I infer that human إقامة is one consciously maintained species-form within that field. An alternative is that the nonhuman الصلاة is categorically unlike the prescribed human prayer and should not revise it.

changed_reading.before: Set up a specifically human ritual obligation.
changed_reading.after: Maintain the human form of a larger, knowingly ordered creaturely response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across 24:47-54, claimed obedience is exposed by turning away, interested submission, and oath display; the valid response is hearing-as-enactment when summoned to judgment, followed by carrying differentiated responsibilities. Obedience to the messenger in the focus is therefore a tested transfer from received call to accountable action.

activation_trace.role: The message-bearer is explicitly included in the verbal claim being tested.
Professed compliance establishes the baseline that subsequent conduct falsifies.
Turning away supplies the behavioral ablation of the spoken obedience claim.
A summons creates the concrete threshold at which allegiance becomes observable.
Judgment between people gives obedience a social and adjudicative object.
Hearing as understanding-and-compliance fuses reception with enactment.
The immediate 'we obey' completes the valid response to the summons.
Recognizably good conduct displaces maximal oath performance as the required evidence.
Three obedience forms make responsive action the repeated hinge of the concluding instruction.
Distinct carried trusts prevent obedience from erasing differentiated accountability.
Gentle direction to a path is presented as the result of enacted obedience.
The messenger's carried message is bounded by the stated duty of clear delivery.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts speech, turning away, selective coming, hearing-and-obeying, oath display, known conduct, assigned burdens, and guidance.
The messenger's obligation and the audience's obligation are grammatically distinguished in 24:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tests that separate claim, summons, judgment, conduct, and burden; I infer a transfer mechanism from heard message to accountable action. A live alternative is a simpler authority test with no special emphasis on the hearing-action transition.

changed_reading.after: Make the carried call executable when it reaches judgment and conduct, without replacing action by claims, advantageous compliance, or emphatic oaths.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding promise moves through succession, enablement of an accepted order, and substitution of security for fear before the focus supplies its practice-chain. The focus reads as the repeatable maintenance of promised public order: worship, redistribution, and responsive transmission keep security from becoming a merely announced state.

activation_trace.role: A promise opens the hoped-for public condition that the following imperatives operationalize.
One root spans trusting commitment and settled security, linking agents to the condition promised.
Successive standing-in-place gives the promise an intergenerational and institutional horizon.
Enablement and effective capacity make the promised order operative rather than nominal.
An order of allegiance and compliance is the thing being enabled.
One condition taking another's place supplies the promise's explicit social transformation.
Expected harm is the displaced condition against which security becomes legible.
Ongoing maintenance anchors the promised order in repeated practice.
Enacted compliance supplies the public order's responsive linkage.
Received care qualifies the resulting order by protection rather than domination.

structural_cues: 24:55 and 24:56 are adjacent, with 24:56 beginning by conjunction after the promise.
The promise names succession, enablement, fear-to-security substitution, and worship before the focus gives three imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and a move from promised states to imperatives; I infer that the practices maintain or enact the promise rather than purchase it. A live alternative is that 24:56 is an independent exhortative seal and not an operational continuation of 24:55.

changed_reading.before: A devotional formula following a political promise.
changed_reading.after: The recurring practical form through which promised security, enabled order, and non-dominating care become inhabitable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two named prayers immediately become boundaries for household permission at exposed times. Established prayer thus functions not only as worship but as a shared clock that coordinates access, vulnerability, and privacy.

activation_trace.role: Permission supplies the access-control action organized around the prayer times.
The two prescribed prayers serve as publicly recognizable temporal markers.
A defined time makes the household rule temporal rather than merely spatial.
Covered vulnerability explains why the prayer-marked times require guarded entry.

structural_cues: 24:58 names prayer before dawn and prayer at night among three permission windows.
The windows are explicitly called three private exposures and are followed by relaxed access outside them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prayer names as boundaries in a permission schedule; I infer that established prayer provides shared social time for protecting vulnerability. An alternative is that the prayers are convenient clock references with no reciprocal effect on the meaning of إقامة الصلاة.

changed_reading.after: Keep a common temporal architecture by which a household can know when access must yield to protected vulnerability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, mercy recurs at points where severe norms could become terminal exclusion: repentance and reform, accusation procedure, slander restraint, forgiving others, coerced vulnerability, and permission within a collective matter. The focus's passive 'that you may be shown mercy' therefore names entry into a repeated repair regime, not only a deferred reward.

activation_trace.role: Merciful care follows repentance and reform, keeping sanction from being the final social state.
Mercy frames the accusation procedure with care beyond its adversarial form.
Mercy interrupts the threatened consequence of circulating ungrounded speech.
Repeated mercy closes the warning about desiring scandal's spread with a doubled care-frame.
Mercy follows material giving, pardon, and overlooking, joining received forgiveness to enacted repair.
Mercy addresses persons subjected to coercion, marking care at a site of unequal power.
Mercy follows permission and requested forgiveness within a collective matter, extending repair into governance.
The focus's passive mercy clause gathers the recurrent repair pattern into the command sequence.

structural_cues: Mercy language repeatedly appears after procedural, reputational, economic, coercive, or collective vulnerabilities.
The focus uses a passive verb of being shown mercy rather than claiming that the commanded acts mechanically manufacture it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent mercy closures at repair points; I infer a surah-wide recovery architecture gathered by the focus clause. A live alternative is that the recurrences are general reassurance and do not form one procedural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Perform the commands in hope of a general divine reward.
changed_reading.after: Join practices that keep a norm-governed community repairable after fault, accusation, coercion, and strained collective belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later permission to eat across a dense network of family houses and to greet one another as selves activates the kinship branch of mercy. Being shown mercy can be read socially as maintaining porous-but-governed household belonging, where provision and peace circulate across maternal and paternal relations.

activation_trace.role: Kinship in the mercy root anchors the later household network directly in the focus clause.
Repeated dwellings provide the spatial nodes through which food and access circulate.
The mother supplies an explicit generative kinship node in the household list.
Paternal kin extend access beyond the nuclear household.
Maternal uncles and their relation balance the paternal extension of the network.
Greeting as safety and wholeness turns entry into an exchange of protected belonging.

structural_cues: 24:61 repeats houses through a long bilateral kinship list, then permits eating together or separately.
Entering houses culminates in greeting 'yourselves,' collapsing host and guest into one relational body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship houses, shared provision, self-directed greeting, and the kinship branch of رحم; I infer that mercy has a household circulation form. An alternative is that 24:61 only regulates lawful access and does not retrospectively specify the mercy of 24:56.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an undifferentiated favor received by compliant individuals.
changed_reading.after: Mercy also takes social form as provision, safe entry, and peace circulating through an extended kinship body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects branch-distant material images of channels, growth, transmission, womb, cloud, rain, and originating water. It remains anchored in the focus roots for maintaining, giving, zakat, sending, and mercy, while 24:43-45 supplies an explicit whole-surah flow sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for social circulation, never as a lexical claim that the commands literally mean irrigation or gestation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ق و م as support, ء ت ي as directing a watercourse, ز ك و as growth, ر س ل as release/transmission, and ر ح م as womb.

activation_trace.role: A load-bearing support supplies the stable frame through which beneficial flows can continue.
Directed water passage supplies the focus's strongest internal hydraulic image.
Growth identifies the life-producing result of properly directed transfer.
Release and dispatch make guidance another flow that must be allowed to travel.
The womb supplies a protected generative receiving-space for the converging flows.
Gentle propulsion initiates the packet's cloud-to-rain transport sequence.
The moving cloud provides the carrier in the contextual flow model.
Descending rain is the delivered beneficial substance emerging from the carrier.
Gaps provide the apertures through which the delivered substance exits.
Water as the stated origin of living creatures confirms the generative side of circulation.

changed_reading.before: A command list whose three acts are joined only by religious category.
changed_reading.after: A cautiously modeled life-system: stable practice supports directed material and message flows whose growth is received within protective mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the split prayer-root's fire and fire-straightening branches rather than its ordinary worship branch. It remains anchored in ص ل و and the focus's إقامة and purification sequence, while the lamp passage supplies ignition and light. Downstream prose must mark it as a tempering analogy for disciplined formation, not as a translation of الصلاة or a claim that ritual worship is punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ص ل و through the fire/tempering branches, joined to ق و م as straightness and ز ك و as purification.

activation_trace.role: Contact with heat supplies the remote material condition of the tempering model.
Straightening an object by controlled fire supplies the model's formative operation.
Straightness and balance identify the disciplined shape being maintained.
Purification supplies the non-destructive aim of repeated formative exposure.
Layered illumination supplies the constructive visible result of controlled burning.
Ignition gives the contextual lamp its transformative heat-source.
The possibility of fire's effect without direct touch keeps the analogy at controlled influence rather than destructive contact.

changed_reading.after: Prayer may be pictured, cautiously, as repeated controlled exposure that straightens and clarifies conduct so giving and obedience become formed responses.

strongest_changes: The exact prayer-zakat pair in 24:37 turns two personal duties into a house-based counter-rhythm within commerce.
The 24:47-54 sequence turns obedience from verbal allegiance into hearing enacted through judgment, conduct, and differentiated responsibility.
The promise in 24:55 and privacy schedule in 24:58 make the focus formula public and domestic infrastructure for security.
The repeated mercy closures make تُرْحَمُونَ the gathering point of a surah-wide repair regime.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the compact formula operate across attention, value circulation, adjudication, public security, household time, kinship access, and recovery after harm; the natural middle passage also supported tightly contained material analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Adjacency supports but does not prove that 24:56 operationally maintains the promise of 24:55.
The creaturely prayer of 24:41 may broaden the human prayer command or may remain categorically distinct from it.
The hydraulic and tempering models depend on remote branches and should remain exploratory analogies.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The three imperatives maintain the security just promised.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ق و م` B002 is upright standing and B004 care, guardianship, and preservation; `ص ل و` B003 is prescribed worship; `ز ك و` B001 is growth/increase and B002 purity; `ط و ع` B001 is willing yielding; `ر ح م` B001 is beneficent mercy and B002 relational bond. **Structural cue:** 24:51-55 move from responsive judgment through distributed loads to enabled security; 24:58-61 then regulate household privacy and shared eating. **Assigned role:** establishing keeps worship standing, alms circulate purifying growth, and obedience coordinates the public message; mercy preserves the relations these practices maintain. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies promised order followed immediately by recurring practices and then domestic effects; I infer security → requires maintenance, and maintained worship/transfer/coordination → durable merciful relations. **Reading change:** the imperatives are operational upkeep for the promised social condition, not a disconnected ritual coda.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:58-61 showed what maintenance produces at household scale: predictable privacy, mature permission, reduced burden, and inclusive shared provision. Mercy therefore preserves circulation by ordering it.

The channel supports clear conveyance as controlled propagation, not uncontrolled rumor.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni dik konuma getirme ve dik durma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadet sırasındaki duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde dik kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dikilme ve dik duruşla sınırlıdır; niyet, gözetim ve yerleşme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Fiziksel dik duruş çekirdeği korunur; belirli duruş ve kök üzerinde kalma anlatımları ona bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın ya da başka bir varlığın dik konuma gelmesi veya dik durumda bulunmasıdır. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadetteki ayakta duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel duruşun özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.
Tek ayağa kalkış, ibadet duruşu, kökü üzerinde dik kalan bitki ve duran hayvan fiziksel çekirdeğin bağlama özgü görünümleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikilme ve dik durma çekirdeğinde birleşir; tek bir ayağa kalkışın yanı sıra ibadet, bitki ve hayvan bağlamlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel olarak dik konuma gelme ile o konumda bulunma aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem dikilme hareketini hem de ortaya çıkan dik duruşu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Dik duruşu ve bu duruşun sürmesini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme anlamındaki kararlı niyet ve girişimi destekler. Anlam yalnız zihinsel isteme değil, işe doğru yönelme ve onu üzerine alma aşamasına da bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği bir işi, topluluğu ya da düzeni sürekli gözetmek, korumak ve yönetmektir. Aynı ifadede bir işi üstlenmeye değinen unsur önceki niyet dalıyla örtüştüğünden, burada ancak sürekli sorumluluk ve koruma doğurduğu ölçüde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yönetici ve koruyucu adları ile belirli işi gözetme yapıları ayrıştırılır; yetersizlik anlatımı yalnız kendi sözlük biriminde verilir.

Her şeyi sürekli yönetip koruma ve bir düzenin ayakta kalmasını sağlama, aynı sorumluluğun en geniş uygulamasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi sürdürme, işler ve düzgün durumda tutma ile onun gereğini ve koşullarını eksiksiz yerine getirme anlamlarını destekler. İbadet ve kutsal kitap örnekleri çekirdeği tanımlamaz, bu genel yerine getirme işlemini özelleştirir.

İbadetin ve kutsal kitabın gereklerini uygulamak, genel yerine getirme işleminin özel bağlamıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi devam ettirme ve düzgün durumda tutma ile ona ait gerekleri eksiksiz yerine getirmeyi aynı işlem alanında birleştirir. İbadet ve kitap bu işlemin özel nesneleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yerde kalma eylemini, kalınan ya da ayakta durulan yeri ve kalış zamanını destekler. Oturum ve toplanmış insanlar anlamı, yerleşme çekirdeğinden gelişmiş adlaşmış bir kullanım olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القيمة أصله الواو لأنه يقوم مقام الشيء (sihah)؛ قام فلان مقام فلان إذا ناب عنه؛ يقومان مقامهما (mufradat)؛ أصل القيمة الواو وأصله أنك تقيم هذا مكان ذاك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yolun düz olması, insanın doğru yolu izlemesi, nesnenin düzgünlüğü, işin yoluna girmesi ve sözün adil olması gibi kullanımları ortak bir düzgünlük, denge ve sapmama çekirdeğinde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel veya davranışsal düzgünlük ve dengedir; geçim dayanağı, fiyat ve bedensel duruş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın düzgünlük ve denge çekirdeği tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış fiyat veya geçim anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yolun, nesnenin, kişinin davranışının, işin ya da sözün eğrilikten ve aşırılıktan uzak, düzgün, dengeli ve doğru olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey fiziksel, davranışsal veya yargısal olarak düz çizgisini korur, dengeli olur ve sapmaz.
Doğru yolda kalma, doğru inanç düzeni ve adil söz, düzgünlük çekirdeğinin davranış ve değer alanına uzanmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar fiziksel düzgünlük, dengelilik ve bir çizgiden sapmama çekirdeğini insan davranışına, işe, inanç düzenine ve söze genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: düzgünlük, denge ve doğru yoldan sapmama
concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel düzgünlükten davranışsal doğruluğa uzanan ortak çekirdeği eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Düzgünlük, denge ve doğru çizgiyi sürdürme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan, davranış, söz veya işin ölçülü ve doğru olması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Davranışsal doğruluk ve dengeyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düzgün ve dengeli olmak; doğru yoldan ayrılmamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğru yolda kalma, davranışsal doğruluk, sağlam inanç düzeni ve adil söz alanlarına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi düzelterek düzgün hale getirme işlemini ve beden, organ, sıcaklık gibi alanlardaki dengeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da eğrilik ve aşırılıktan uzak düzgünlük ile denge durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düzgünlük durumunu davranış ve doğruluk alanına genişletir; komşu dal düzeltme işlemini ve fiziksel denge örneklerini daha çok öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; durum, düzeltme işlemi ve davranışsal kapsam farkını gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استقامة الطريق أو الإنسان أو الأمر، والاعتدال والاستواء، والقويم والقيم والدين المستقيم وعدل الكلام
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو قوام المعاش ولا مجرد القيام بالبدن ولا قيمة السلعة
branches.source_phrase_ar: رمح قويم ورجل قويم؛ القيمة الملة المستقيمة؛ إذا انقاد واستمرت طريقته فقد استقام (ayn)؛ الاستقامة الاعتدال؛ استقام له الأمر؛ قومت الشيء فهو قويم أي مستقيم؛ القوام العدل؛ دينا قيما (sihah)؛ الاستقامة على الطاعة؛ القيم هو المستقيم؛ أقوم كلاما أي أعدل كلاما (tahdhib)؛ الاستقامة في الطريق الذي يكون على خط مستو؛ استقامة الإنسان لزومه المنهج المستقيم؛ دينا قيما أي ثابتا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin ayakta kalmasını sağlayan dayanak, düzen, temel unsur ve geçim aracı çekirdeğini destekler. Bedenin bütünlüğü, işin düzeni ve dünya ile sonrası için geçim bu işlevsel dayanma ilişkisinin uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyin sürmesini sağlayan dayanak ve geçim temelidir; gözetim eylemi veya beden boyu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dayanak ve sürdürme aracı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki yönetim, boy ve fiyat anlamları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düzenin, bedenin veya yaşamın ayakta kalmasını sağlayan temel dayanak, düzenleyici unsur ya da yeterli geçim aracıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin varlığını ve düzenini sürdürmesini sağlayan temel dayanak veya düzenleyici unsur bulunur.
Yaşamı ve bedeni sürdüren yeterli geçim aracı, genel dayanak işlevinin özel gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir işin veya varlığın ayakta kalmasını sağlayan dayanak, düzen ve temel unsurda birleşir; yaşamı ve bedeni sürdüren geçim de aynı işlev üzerinden açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: ayakta tutan dayanak ve geçim temeli
concept_gloss.applicability: Düzeni, bedeni veya yaşamı sürdüren temel unsur ve geçim aracını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Dayanak, düzeni sürdürme ve yeterli geçim işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin veya düzenin varlığını sürdüren vazgeçilmez unsur bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel olma ve düzeni ayakta tutma işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi ayakta tutan dayanak, düzen ve geçim temeli

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedenin bütünlüğünü, yaşamın geçimini ve hem dünya hem sonrası için sürdürme araçlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin dayandığı ana unsur ile kalbin bedendeki merkezî rolünü özellikle örnekler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işin veya bütünün ayakta kalmasını sağlayan ana unsuru anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dayanak kavramını geçim ve bedenin sürmesi alanlarına genişletir; komşu dal işin ya da bedenin ana taşıyıcı unsuruna daha dar biçimde odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; temel dayanakla geçim kapsamı arasındaki farkı açıklayan aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القيام أو القوام لما يقوم به الشيء ويثبت، وعماد الأمر ونظامه وملاكه، وما يقيم العيش والجسم والمعاش
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الرعاية والولاية نفسها ولا الطول والقامة ولا ثمن السلعة
branches.source_phrase_ar: هذا الأمر لا قومية له أي لا قوام له؛ القوام من العيش ما يقيمك ويغنيك؛ القيام العماد؛ قوام كل شيء ما استقام به (ayn)؛ قوام الأمر نظامه وعماده؛ قوام الأمر ملاكه؛ جعل الله لكم قياما (sihah)؛ قوام الأمر وملاكه؛ تقيمكم فتقومون بها؛ قوام الجسم تمامه؛ قوام كل شيء ما استقام به (tahdhib)؛ القيام والقوام اسم لما يقوم به الشيء؛ جعلها مما يمسككم؛ قياما للناس أي قواما لهم يقوم به معاشهم ومعادهم (mufradat)؛ قوام الدين والحق أي به يقوم (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir malın bedelini belirleme işlemini, bu işlemle ortaya çıkan değeri ve tarafların bu değer üzerinde hesaplaşmasını destekler. Bir şeyin yerini tutma düşüncesi kökensel açıklamadır; dalın güncel çekirdeği değer biçme ve belirlenen bedeldir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekonomik değer biçme ve bedelle sınırlıdır; genel olarak başkasının yerini alma veya temel dayanak değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Belirlenen bedel ile mala değer biçme yapıları ayrılır; kapsam genel değiş tokuşa veya yerini tutmaya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir malın parasal değerini belirlemek ve bu değerlendirme sonucunda ortaya çıkan bedeldir; tarafların değer üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması da bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir mala değer biçilir ve bu işlem sonucunda onun bedeli belirlenir.
Tarafların bir malın değeri üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması, değer biçme çekirdeğine bağlı kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, malın bedelini değerlendirme yoluyla belirleme ve belirlenen değeri adlandırma çekirdeğinde birleşir; karşılıklı değer hesabı da buna bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Değerlendirme işlemi ile bu işlemden çıkan parasal sonucu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Değer biçme işlemini ve belirlenen bedeli korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın parasal karşılığının değerlendirme yoluyla saptandığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mala değer biçme işlemini ve parasal sonucu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: malın değerini belirlemek veya ulaştığı bedeli bildirmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malın değerini değerlendirme yoluyla belirleme işlemini ve belirlenen değeri içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Satışta alınan karşılığı, değiş tokuş bedelini, bedelin çokluğunu ve şeyin pahalı oluşunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir malın parasal değeri ve satışta karşılık olarak verilen bedel alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değer biçme işlemi ve bunun sonucuna dayanır; komşu dal satış karşılığını ve bedelin yüksekliğini de kapsayan daha geniş bir alışveriş alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; değer biçme ile satış karşılığı arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القيمة ثمن الشيء، وتقويم السلعة أو المتاع، والتقاوم أو الاستقامة بمعنى بيان القيمة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النيابة العامة ولا القوام بمعنى العماد
branches.source_phrase_ar: القيمة ثمن الشيء بالتقويم؛ تقاوموا فيما بينهم (ayn)؛ قومت السلعة؛ استقمت السلعة؛ القيمة واحدة القيم (sihah)؛ القيمة ثمن الشيء بالتقويم؛ تقاوموه فيما بينهم؛ استقمت المتاع أي قومته؛ قامت الأمة مائة دينار أي بلغت قيمتها (tahdhib)؛ تقويم السلعة بيان قيمتها (mufradat)؛ قومت الشيء تقويما؛ أصل القيمة الواو (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan bedeninin dik duruşla ölçülen boyunu, beden yapısını ve özellikle düzgün, güzel boyu destekler. Bedenin bütünlüğüne değinen unsur burada uzunluk ve dış yapı açısından anlaşılmalı, geçim veya düzen dayanağıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın boyu ve düzgün beden yapısıyla sınırlıdır; kuyu aracı veya başka nesnelerin dik parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: İnsanın boy ve düzgün beden yapısı tanımlanır; araç parçaları ve geçim dayanağı anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın ayakta dururken görülen boy ölçüsü, dik beden yapısı ve özellikle düzgün, güzel uzunluğudur.

facets.statement: İnsanın dik bedeni üzerinden belirlenen boyu ve dış beden yapısı anlatılır.
Boyun düzgün ve güzel olması, genel beden ölçüsünün olumlu nitelendirilmiş biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanın ayakta duruşla ölçülen boyu ve beden yapısında birleşir; düzgün ve güzel uzunluk bu ölçünün nitelendirilmiş biçimi olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: insanın boyu ve düzgün beden yapısı
concept_gloss.applicability: Boy ölçüsü, dik duruş ve güzel uzunluk bileşenlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan boyunu, dik beden yapısını ve düzgün uzunluğu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanın beden uzunluğunun olumlu biçimde nitelendirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyu, düzgünlüğü ve olumlu dış görünüşü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düzgün ve güzel boy; beden yapısı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ayakta duruşla ölçülen boyu, dik beden yapısını ve özellikle düzgün uzunluğu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boyun yanında bedenin, yüzün ve genel dış görünüşün güzel oluşunu daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanın boyunu, beden yapısını ve dış görünüşünü anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği boy ölçüsü ve düzgün uzunluktur; komşu dal yüz ve genel görünüşü de içine alan daha geniş bir beden betimlemesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; boy ölçüsüyle genel dış görünüş arasındaki sınırı açıklayan aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القامة مقدار طول الإنسان أو قامته، والقوام والقومية وحسن الطول، وانتصاب القامة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو القامة بمعنى آلة البئر ولا قائمة السيف والدابة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القامة مقدار قيام الرجل؛ قوام الجسم تمامه وطوله (ayn)؛ قوام الرجل قامته وحسن طوله؛ قامة الإنسان قده (sihah)؛ القامة قامة الرجل؛ حسن القامة والقمة والقومية؛ قوام الجسم تمامه (tahdhib)؛ تقويم الإنسان في أحسن تقويم؛ انتصاب القامة (mufradat)؛ القوام الطول الحسن؛ القومية القوام والقامة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuyu düzeneğini, kılıç sapını, yatak ve hayvan gibi varlıkların dik parçasını ve çiftçinin tuttuğu ahşap parçayı aynı araç-parça alanında toplar. Kuyu başında insan biçimli yapı açıklaması açıkça tartışmalıdır ve güvenilir çekirdek olarak sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal araç ve dik parça adlarıyla sınırlıdır; tartışmalı insan biçimli kuyu yapısı yalnız kaynak görüşü olarak belirtilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kuyu aracı, sap, ayak ve çiftçi çubuğu ayrı araç-parça görünümleri olarak tutulur; tartışmalı yorum genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir düzeneğin dik duran, taşıyan veya elle tutulan parçasıdır; kuyu makarası ve donanımı, kılıç sapı, yatak ya da hayvan ayağı ve çiftçinin tuttuğu ahşap parça bu alandadır. Kuyu başında insan biçimli yapı yorumu tartışmalıdır.

facets.statement: Bir araç veya varlığın dik duran, taşıyan ya da elle tutulan işlevsel parçası adlandırılır.
Kuyu başında insan biçiminde yapılmış bir düzenek açıklaması aktarılmış, fakat başka bir kaynakça yorumunda yanlış sayılmıştır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt kuyu makarası ve donanımı, kılıç sapı, yatak veya hayvanın dik parçası ile çiftçinin tuttuğu ahşabı araç-parça alanında toplar. Kuyu başındaki insan biçimli yapı açıklaması aktarılırken buna karşı çıkan düzeltme de birlikte korunmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: düzeneğin dik, taşıyıcı veya tutulan parçası
concept_gloss.applicability: Kuyu aracı, sap, ayak ve tutma çubuğunun ortak işlevsel parça niteliğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Araç, dik parça, taşıma ve elle tutma işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun kuyudan çekilmesinde kullanılan makara ve ona bağlı düzenek bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu aracı ile ona bağlı donanımın işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kuyu makarası veya ona bağlı donanım
kuyu başındaki insan biçimli yapı diye aktarılmış, fakat yanlış sayılmış yorum
kılıç sapı veya yatak, masa ve hayvanın dik duran parçası

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuyu makarası ve donanımının yanında kılıç sapı, mobilya ya da hayvan ayağı ve çiftçi çubuğunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyunun başındaki iki destek ile bunların taşıdığı yatay ahşap ve makaradan oluşan belirli yapıyı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kuyu başındaki taşıyıcı parçalar ve su çekme düzeneği alanına girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal farklı araçların işlevsel parçalarını bir araya getirir; komşu dal yalnız kuyunun iki desteği ve üzerindeki düzenek için belirli bir yapısal addır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kuyu düzeneğindeki ortak alanı ve parça kapsamındaki farkı gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القامة للبكرة أو أداتها عند البئر، وقائم السيف، وقائمة السرير والخوان والدابة، والخشبة التي يمسكها الحراث
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو قامة الإنسان ولا القوم جماعة الناس
branches.source_phrase_ar: القامة مقدار قيام الرجل كهيئة الرجل يبنى على شفير بئر؛ قائم السيف مقبضه؛ قائمة السرير والخوان والدابة (ayn)؛ القامة البكرة بأداتها؛ قائم السيف وقائمته مقبضه؛ القائمة واحدة قوائم الدواب؛ المقوم الخشبة التي يمسكها الحراث (sihah)؛ القامة البكرة التي يستقى بها الماء؛ النعامة الخشبة المعترضة ثم تعلق القامة؛ قائم السيف مقبضه وما سوى ذلك فهو قائمة (tahdhib)؛ القامة البكرة بأداتها (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dünyanın sonundaki diriliş gününü, son saatin gerçekleşmesini ve insanların yargılanmak üzere ayağa kalkmasını aynı olay olarak tanımlar. Bu, sıradan ayağa kalkıştan ayrılmış zaman ve inanç alanına ait bir addır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız son saatteki toplu diriliş ve yargılanma günüdür; sıradan kalkma veya yerleşme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad, son saatteki diriliş ve insanların yargı için ayağa kalktığı günle sınırlı tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Dünyanın sonundaki saatin gerçekleştiği, ölülerin diriltildiği ve insanların yargılanmak üzere ayağa kalktığı gündür.

facets.statement: Son saat gerçekleşir, ölüler diriltilir ve insanlar yargılanmak üzere ayağa kalkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar son saatin gerçekleşmesi, ölülerin diriltilmesi ve insanların yargılanmak üzere ayağa kalkmasını tek bir son gün anlatımında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: ölülerin diriltildiği ve insanların yargı için kalktığı gün
concept_gloss.applicability: Son saat, diriliş ve toplu yargılanma aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Son günü, dirilişi ve insanların yargı için ayağa kalkmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölülerin yeniden yaşama döndürülüp insanların hesap vermek üzere toplandığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Diriliş ve yargılanma günü anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı, ateş yanında ısınmayı, bir şeyi ateşle pişirip yakmayı, ateşe atmayı, yakacağı ve zorluğa katlanma aktarımını birlikte doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşma çekirdektir; pişirme, yakma, düzeltme, yakacak ve zorluğa katlanma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin ateş ve yakacak anlamlarını korurken yalnız belirli kuruluşlarda görülen ısınma, düzeltme ve zorluğa katlanma anlamlarını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin içine girerek ya da yanında bulunarak onun yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı anlatır; ateşte eti pişirme ile değneği ateşte yumuşatıp düzeltme gibi ateşle işleme anlamları belirli kuruluşlara bağlıdır. Ateşi besleyen yakacak adı ile bir işin ağır sıkıntısını çekme anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
Kişi ateşin yanında durarak onun sıcaklığıyla ısınır.
Belirli kuruluşlarda et ateşte pişirilir veya değnek ateşte yumuşatılıp düzeltilir.
Ad biçimi ateşi tutuşturup sürdürmeye yarayan yakacağı, ayrıca ateşte pişirme işini belirtebilir.
Ateşin yakıcılığı, bir işin ağırlığını ve sıkıntısını çekmeye aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ateşin sıcaklığını çekme ve ateşle işleme çekirdeğini; ısınma, pişirme, yakma, değnek düzeltme, yakacak ve ağır bir işe katlanma yönleriyle genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: ateşin yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalma ve ateşle işleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Ateşe girme veya onun ısısını çekme çekirdeğini, ateşle pişirme, yakma ve biçim verme işlemleriyle birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşle karşılaşmayı, yakıcı ısıyı çekmeyi ve ateşle bir nesne üzerinde işlem yapmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlının ateşin içine girdiği, orada kaldığı veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını çektiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Ateş yanında ısınma, nesneyi ateşle işleme, yakacak ve zorluğa katlanma yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Et ya da başka bir nesnenin ateşe tutulduğu veya başka birinin ateşe atıldığı geçişli kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Öznenin ateş sıcaklığını çekmesi, ısınması, yakacak anlamı ve sıkıntıya katlanması kaybolur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlar için başkasına iyilik dileme anlamını, Tanrı için esirgeme, övme, bağışlama ve değer verme anlamlarını, melekler içinse bağışlanma dileğini açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkası için iyilik istemeyi anlatır; özne Tanrı olduğunda esirgeme, güzel sözle anma, bağışlama ve değerini onaylama, melekler olduğunda ise bağışlanma ve iyilik isteme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi başkası için iyilik, esenlik ve iyi sonuç diler.

Özne melekler olduğunda başkası için bağışlanma ve iyilik isteme anlamı öne çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım başkası için iyilik dilemeyi temel alır ve özneye göre Tanrı'nın esirgemesi, övmesi, bağışlaması ve değer vermesi ile meleklerin bağışlanma istemesini ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ayakta durma, eğilme, yere kapanma, dilek ve yüceltme bölümleri bulunan, kuralları belirlenmiş tapınmayı ve bu tapınmanın bütün gereklerini yerine getirmeyi açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada genel iyilik dileği değil, bölümleri ve yerine getirilmesi gereken koşulları bulunan belirli tapınma eylemi tanımlanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin kurallı tapınma anlamı korunur; bütün hak ve koşulları yerine getirme vurgusu yalnız bunu bildiren özel kuruluşta tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ayakta durma, eğilme, yere kapanma, dilekte bulunma ve yüceltme gibi belirli bölümleri bulunan kurallı bir tapınma eylemidir. Onu yerine getirmek, yalnız hareketleri yapmak değil, bütün gerek ve koşullarını gözetmektir.

facets.statement: Kuralları belirlenmiş tapınma, ayakta durma, eğilme, yere kapanma, dilek ve yüceltme bölümlerini içerir.
Bu tapınmanın yerine getirilmesi, ona ait bütün gerekleri ve koşulları eksiksiz gözetmeyi gerektirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ayakta durma, eğilme ve yere kapanma başta olmak üzere belirli bölümleri bulunan kurallı tapınmayı ve onun gereklerini eksiksiz yerine getirmeyi bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli hareket, söz ve koşulları bulunan tapınma eyleminin tamamını belirtir; yalnız genel bir dileği anlatmaz.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmanın kurallı niteliğini, temel beden duruşlarını ve bütün olarak yerine getirilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuralları belirli, ayakta durma, eğilme ve yere kapanma bölümleri bulunan tapınmanın Türkçedeki doğal kısa adıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi avı ya da başka bir şeyi yakalamak için kurulan tuzakları ve buradan türeyen, bir kimseyi yıkıma düşürmek amacıyla iş çevirme kullanımını birlikte destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kurulan yakalama aracı çekirdektir; bir kişiyi zarara düşürmek için düzen kurma anlamı bu çekirdeğin insana aktarılmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin tuzak adı korunur; bir kişi için gizlice düzen kurma anlamı yalnız onu bildiren özel kuruluşla sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Avın ya da başka bir hedefin içine düşüp yakalanması için kurulan tuzaktır. Bir kimseyi zarara veya yıkıma düşürmek amacıyla gizlice iş çevirme anlamı bu araçtan türeyen bağlı kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir hedefin içine düşerek yakalanması için tuzak veya benzeri bir araç kurulur.
Tuzak düşüncesi, bir kimseyi zarara veya yıkıma düşürmek için gizlice düzen kurmaya aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, avı veya başka bir hedefi yakalamak üzere kurulan tuzağı temel alır ve aynı yapıyı bir kişiyi yıkıma sürükleyecek düzen kurmaya taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın önceden kurulmasını, hedefin ona düşmesini ve yakalanma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.text: birini tuzağa düşürmek için düzen kurmak
contextual_glosses.applicability: Somut av aracının bir kişiyi zarara veya yıkıma götürecek gizli girişime aktarıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hedefi önceden hazırlanmış bir düzenle zarara düşürme düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Av veya başka bir hedef için kurulan somut yakalama aracını doğrudan adlandırmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak daldaki kişiye yönelik düzen kurma, tuzak çekirdeğinden türeyen bağımlı bir kullanımdır ve kartların temel sınırını değiştirmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem insan ve dört ayaklılarda sırtın orta bölümünü hem de kuyruğun iki yanındaki bölgeleri belirtir; dişinin doğumunda bu bölgenin açılması ve devenin doğuma yaklaşması da açıkça desteklenir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anatomik bölge çekirdektir; doğum sırasında açılma ve yavrunun bu bölgeye inmesi aynı bölgeye bağlı durumları anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın anatomik adlar temel alınır; doğum sırasında bölgenin açılması ve devenin doğuma yaklaşması yalnız ilgili kuruluşlarda korunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya dört ayaklı bir hayvanda sırtın orta bölümünü ve özellikle kuyruk kökünün iki yanını kapsayan anatomik bölgedir. Dişide doğum sırasında bu bölgenin açılması ve yavrunun oraya inerek doğumun yaklaşması, bölgeye bağlı durumlardır.

facets.statement: İnsan ve dört ayaklılarda sırtın orta bölümü ile kuyruk kökünün iki yanı adlandırılır.
Dişinin doğumunda bu bölge açılır; devede yavrunun buraya inmesi doğumun yaklaştığını gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sırtın ortası ile kuyruk kökünün iki yanındaki anatomik bölgeyi tanımlar; doğum sırasında açılmayı ve yavrunun bu bölgeye inmesini ona bağlı durumlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: sırtın ortası ve kuyruk kökünün iki yanı
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya dört ayaklı hayvanın sırt ve kuyruk kökü çevresindeki anatomik bölgesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sırtın orta bölümünü ve kuyruğun sağ ile sol yanındaki eşlenik bölgeleri birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişinin doğumu sırasında anatomik bölgenin gevşeyip açıldığı veya yavrunun oraya indiği bağlamlara özgüdür.
